newsitem.title: USA: Micron Elec sees margins down slightly.
newsitem.headline: Micron Elec sees margins down slightly.

text.p: Micron Electronics Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Joseph Daltoso said that he expects the company's gross profit margins to decline slightly going forward from the current margin of 19.6 percent of revenues in the first quarter.
He also said that the company is participating in the "explosive growth" of the direct PC market, which is growing twice as fast as the rest of the personal computer industry.
The overall personal computer industry is forecast to grow at about 15 to 20 percent this year.
Deltoso told a Goldman Sachs Technology Conference that his company and other PC makers have been recently benefiting from lower prices in memory chips. "That will probably dissipate,"
Deltoso said, referring to the expected uptick in memory chip prices. "We are looking at a margin that is a little bit less in the long term than what we see today."
But he added that the company's goal is to offset potential margin declines with revenue growth.
When asked about PC demand and the reports by retailers of a lackluster Christmas, Deltoso said that direct sellers of PC's had a good holiday season.
"We are very pleased with where our December came in," he said.
